name: Proselytes
overview: Scripture defines proselytes as those who enter into covenant with the Lord through circumcision and commitment to observe His law, as shown in Genesis 17:13 and Exodus 12:48-49. While strangers who keep the Passover and are circumcised are welcomed as if born in the land, certain nations like the Ammonites and Moabites are permanently excluded from the congregation (Deuteronomy 23:3), whereas descendants of Egyptians and Edomites may enter by the third generation (Deuteronomy 23:7-8). These regulations emphasize the seriousness of covenant membership and the need for holiness among those who join God's people.
